narr: A warm front stalled across Connecticut and Rhode Island, producing thunderstorms with very heavy rainfall. Also, wind shear was just strong enough for a few thunderstorms to become severe in both Connecticut and Massachusetts, with locally damaging wind gusts.
ev: In East Hartford, Brewer St was flooded with depth up to the wheel base of sedans.
